correctness.rationale: All F_c(x)=x_2+(c/2)(||x||^2-1)exp[-(||x||^2-1)^2] restrict to the identical circle objective -cos(phi). The ambient gradient at the constrained minimizer is (0,1-c). Direct differentiation of the actual EMA-before-projection and normalized retraction gives z_{t+1}=(I+beta_t A+beta_t^2 C)z_t with beta_t=t^-1/2, A=[[-theta(1-c),-theta],[c,-1]], C=[[-theta c,theta],[0,0]], normal memory factor 1-beta_t. det A=theta>0, tr A=theta(c-1)-1, giving the exact Hurwitz threshold c<1+1/theta. A positive definite Lyapunov metric makes sufficiently late updates contract by order beta_t in the stable region; for c>threshold, -A is Hurwitz and metric expansion of every nonzero active perturbation follows. Sum beta_t diverges. Independently differentiated the original nonlinear update and checked its Jacobian. Critical equality not classified; full nonlinear attraction not claimed.
residual_risks: Deterministic St(2,1), beta_t=t^-1/2, mu_t=theta beta_t, normalized tangent retraction, late-time linearized perturbations; critical parameter and nonlinear global attraction left open.
